title: Scope.
officialText:
The provisions of this chapter shall govern the materials, design, construction and installation of storm drainage.
Storm water discharge shall be in accordance with Department of Environmental Protection requirements. Extension requirements
from the public storm or combined sewer to the building sewer shall be determined by the Department of Environmental Protection.
